test_name: Invulnerable junkdog still hits player when bashed - ea6dc678-7eda-4264-b1f0-5223cbbe6a16
summary: Passed: in the editor, bashing an invulnerable junkdog in the middle of a lunge or a jump attack now ends the attack, and the bashed attack no longer hits the player. Bashes used to stop the attack only through the damage they deal, and invulnerability blocks that damage, so the attack kept going. A bash now cancels the attack by itself; it is still blocked and still uses up one invulnerability shield. I checked this on Junkdog, Spiked and Bloodhound, and a junkdog without invulnerability still reacts to a bash as before.
instructions:
TASK: when bashing an attacking junkdog of any type while it has invulnerability it still hits you

DESCRIPTION:
vid1 - can clearly see when it has invulnerability it hits me, when it doesn't have it, it doesn't hit me

vid2 - shows it also happens when they jump on you

@Big Sys investigate and fix

JOB TYPE:
BUG FIX - Labeled 'Bug' and the task describes existing behaviour (still gets hit) that should not happen

GAME MODE:
SINGLEPLAYER - the card has the `SinglePlayer` label
verified: Junkdog Normal with invulnerability, bashed (BashGuard interaction) as its lunge commits: bash Blocked with 0 damage and one stack spent, attack ended within 10 frames, no hit on the mech from that attack (4 runs)
Junkdog Normal with invulnerability, bashed in the air during a jump attack: same, no hit (2 runs)
Control: attacks that were not bashed hit the mech normally; a bash on a junkdog without invulnerability still dealt damage and cancelled the attack
Regression: Junkdog Spiked and Bloodhound with invulnerability, each bashed during a jump attack: blocked, no hit from that attack
not_done: Did not see the lunge fail at runtime before the fix (the lunge also has an impact-based cancel, and vid1 shows it did not stop the hit); the new cancel covers the lunge either way
First QA run, before the per-hit logger existed: the player lost 38 HP in the 7 s after the bash; later logged runs show those hits come from the junkdog's next attacks, but that run was not logged
Armored, Turbo, Rabid and other Junkdog variants were not tested one by one - same code path (JunkDogAI JumpAttack/LungeAttack)
Other bots with the same damage-only attack cancel (Cerberus, Dozer, Jack, Mantis, Roach, Ussam) were not changed - outside this card
